info.summary: Open-source HR and payroll administration with built-in labour-law and wage-tax compliance.
Open-source HR- en salarisadministratie met ingebouwde arbeidsrecht- en loonheffingencompliance.
info.description:
Open-source HR and payroll administration for Dutch and EU employers, built on the OpenRegister data layer.
HRMQ ships a static, versioned corpus of international HR/labour and payroll rules (EU labour directives, ILO conventions, GDPR for employee data, occupational health & safety, national labour law, and payroll / wage-tax & social-security compliance) and an executable RuleEngine that audits the register's HR objects against the machine-checkable rules and reports compliance coverage.
**Key Features**
- **OpenRegister integration** — all Employee / EmploymentContract / Payslip / PayrollRun objects live in the OpenRegister `hrmq` register - **Compliance rule engine** — auto-discovered per-domain CheckProviders enforce the machine-checkable rule corpus - **`occ hrmq:rules:audit`** — reports enforced ÷ machine-checkable coverage, violations, and per-object-type compliance - **`occ hrmq:rules:seed-testdata`** — idempotently seeds compliant local test data - **Full quality pipeline** — PHPCS, PHPMD, Psalm, PHPStan
Free and open source under the EUPL-1.2 license.
**Support:** For support, contact support@conduction.nl.
